# sonarqube_alm_github (Data Source)

Looks up a GitHub DevOps platform setting. Its secrets are not readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_alm_github" "main" {
  key = "github"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the setting.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) GitHub App ID.
- `client_id` (String) GitHub App client ID.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `url` (String) GitHub API URL, e.g. `https://api.github.com/`.
